claim: Test LD A,I / LD A,R parity-flag clearing with real injected interrupts, and keep both IFF read paths at equal fetch counts (six M1s).

evidence.text: 176 ABI cases (all six hooks, four incoming clocks, IFF on and off): 2,114 injected IRQs, 27 of them NMOS LD A,I/R PV-clearing cases; hlib_iff's HLIB_IFF_FIXED_R makes both IFF read paths six M1s.
